means: Transparent pigment on paper - pooled and blooming edges, paper texture showing through, colour that lightens rather than covers.
does: Softens everything: washes replace flat fills, edges bleed, the palette goes pale and backgrounds stop being architectural. SPELLING AND SUFFIX BOTH MATTER: the trained tag is the danbooru medium tag 'watercolor (medium)' - American spelling, plus the '(medium)' disambiguator that exists on danbooru to separate the paint from the colour of water. studio/cards/anime_bg_style.json uses exactly 'watercolor (medium) background, watercolor wash scenery', and its own review recommends keeping the bare medium tag as the anchor and dropping the descriptive tail.
reach_for_it: backgrounds in gentle, domestic or nostalgic scenes, and whole-frame flashbacks
used_in: anime.bg.style/watercolor and shot.fx.bg_treatment/watercolor - whose card review flags the two as duplicates that should be collapsed onto anime.bg.style
